subject: [PATCH v2 2/5] btrfs: split btrfs_insert_delayed_dir_index() into prealloc and commit phases

reviews.author: Qu Wenruo
reviews.summary: The reviewer noted that there are only two call sites using on-stack memory for the prealloc structure and suggested converting to a heap memory based solution. Additionally, they pointed out a potential issue with the lifespan management of btrfs_dir_index_prealloc where it is used as an indicator of whether the structure is properly allocated.

2026-08-06.patch_summary: This patch splits the btrfs_insert_delayed_dir_index() function into three separate functions: prealloc, commit, and free. The prealloc function allocates memory for a delayed node and item before modifying the B-tree, allowing -ENOMEM to be returned cleanly if allocation fails. The commit function populates the item data and inserts it into the rb-tree, while the free function releases pre-allocated resources in case of failure. This refactoring improves error handling and reduces the risk of aborting transactions due to memory allocation failures.
